svg.title: MarketBrain V2 paper-first target architecture, 2026-09-18
svg.desc: PG1 full intelligence uses a planned 15-year history target, fundamentals, news, 5/20/60-session and separate intraday forecasts with controlled learning. PG2 is its shared-workflow INR 100000 paper deployment with ACCEPT/REJECT. Research simulation has separate accounting. Paytm real execution is deferred and disconnected. Dashed boxes are planned or incomplete.
svg.text: MarketBrain: data → forecast → approval → PAPER execution
V2 • PG1: full intelligence + eventual live execution • PG2: mandatory paper-first deployment
Upstox REST / historical data
Existing source: instruments, quotes, candles
Saved quality reused; no reacquisition
Upstox + Paytm live feeds
Planned streaming / read-only integration
Identity, timestamps, gaps and freshness
Marketaux / news events
Connector exists; entity/event work pending
Qwen 1.5B candidate; not validated
Java: 15+ year coverage target, fundamentals + point-in-time features
600-row export verified; Upstox reply pending, training blocked
Versioned historical labels → chronological training/tuning/untouched evaluation; no future leakage
Numerical prediction engine — planned, predictive value not yet established
20-session first → required 5/60-session models; separate 30/60-minute intraday validation
Guards spare-verified; synthetic baseline bundle next; real-data fitting blocked
Java proposal + risk → portal / private Telegram → ACCEPT / REJECT
Existing notification/risk foundations • Planned end-to-end wiring, expiry and price-zone checks
One-time idempotent approval; fresh quote, holdings and risk revalidation before acceptance
PAPER portal + execution + one INR 100,000 ledger — planned workflow
Shared intraday/swing capital; conservative fills, fees, reservations, positions and reconciliation
Isolated research simulation; shared future-live contracts, NOT identical fills or a LIVE switch
Release gate: ≥30 elapsed days AND ≥20 trading sessions
60-session forecasts need full label maturation beyond the operational month
Real Paytm orders: DEFERRED
No execution connection in this release
Governed learning — planned: feedback ≠ correctness; model replacement requires evaluation
Separate user choices, market outcomes, paper fills and research results → mature labels → challenger tests
Explicit promotion / rollback; frozen trial cohorts; no guaranteed improvement or silent active-model changes
Solid green: existing source foundation • Dashed blue: planned / incomplete • Red: excluded current execution scope
Canonical: docs/README.md • Progress: docs/roadmap.md • Source presence ≠ tested readiness ≠ predictive value
